title: The pre-authorized transaction runs and core removes its signer, with no operation
pattern: When a transaction authorized by a T… signer applies, core removes that signer from the account in tx_changes_before. No SET_OPTIONS names it. Readers that track signers only from operations keep a signer that is gone.

hazards.placement: pre-auth signer removed by core in tx_changes_before

facts.says: The transaction has no signatures: the pre-auth signer authorizes it.
Before apply, frank has two signers (T… and X…); after, only the X… signer.
